items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that when the site has products of pairs, the localization functor has a continuous right adjoint given by the product with the localizing object, that this right adjoint defines a morphism of sites whose associated morphism of topoi is the localization, and that the pushforward is computed by evaluating at that product (statement lines 6310-6324). The proof is a short but complete argument: the adjunction is verified by the displayed identification of morphism sets (proof lines 6327-6334); continuity follows from the stability axiom applied to a covering (proof lines 6334-6343); and the remaining assertions follow from the two companion results (proof lines 6343-6345). The non-formal content is the adjunction and the continuity check. The claim is H1: two written-out verifications with the rest attributed.
